newsitem.title: USA: SEC adds Lehman Bros to Centennial civil case.
newsitem.headline: SEC adds Lehman Bros to Centennial civil case.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission Friday added Lehman Bros to its civil action against the former head of Centennial Technologies, Inc.

The SEC's original complaint against Emanuel Pinez, the former chief of the Billierica, Mass.-based personal computer card maker, alleged insider trading and fraud. The agency has moved to freeze Pinez's assets.

Now the SEC is alleging that Lehman is holding the "proceeds of Pinez's ill-gotten gains" and "should have had enough to be very suspicious of his activities," said Jauan Marcel Marcelino, head of the SEC's Boston office.

The SEC staff had sent an investigative document request to Lehman's legal department indicating an informal inquiry was underway and requested Pinez's trading records on January 31. Pinez was able to execute a large number of put and call options a full week later on February 7.
